t: You're looking at the tomb chest of Valentine Cameron Prinsep, in Kensington and Chelsea. He is buried here, and the monument commemorates him. Prinsep was a British painter of the Pre-Raphaelite school, and the tomb marks the resting place of an artist from that circle. The material I have on him is brief, so that is the main thing to take away: a painter of the Pre-Raphaelite school, remembered at this tomb.
